name: monoblogger
description: A terminal-inspired static blog generator with monospace aesthetics

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx serve public
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd public && git add . && git commit -m "Blog update $(date)" && git push origin main
scripts.deploy-msg: npm run build && cd public && git add . && git commit && git push origin main
scripts.sync-source: git add . && git commit -m 'Update source' && git push origin main

author: AJT
